item.title: Banking on Deposits That Can Leave
item.description: Post 1/4 of the No Gut Feelings Bank series. How much maturity transformation does an SA deposit base license, and is the behavioural haircut real? Franchise duration for No Gut Feelings Bank from real Post 1 betas and survival: the licence is 1–7 years per rand, the haircut is zero, and the residual risk lives on the uninsured-share axis, where duration cannot see it.

item.title: What Is a Deposit Actually Worth When Rates Move?
item.description: Post 1/4 of the No Gut Feelings Bank series. I build a behavioural model of non-maturing deposits - current accounts, notice, fixed - from public SARB data, and ask the question every treasury desk worries about: how much of a repo move does a bank pass through to depositors, does it bend with the rate level, and what does getting it wrong cost you? The answer is not in next month’s margin. It is in how badly a constant-beta assumption mismeasures the bank’s interest-rate risk - about a third of a percent of the deposit base under a standard ±200bp shock, in a direction that makes the franchise quietly optionable.
